name: MultiSocial
description: A multilingual dataset and evaluation suite for detecting machine-generated (AI/LLM) social-media posts across languages and platforms.
reputation: New multilingual benchmark (ACL 2025) attracting attention for cross-lingual and platform-robust detection of machine-generated social-media posts.
notes: Caveats include potential contamination from models used to create training data, platform and language distribution shifts, class imbalance, and rapid model improvements that can quickly saturate detection performance.
